layout.narrowViewport: Wrap entries; retain existing two-column mobile layout

behavior: Reuse the single-image AssetPicker; chosen clothing image creates a lingerie workflow node on its right. The node shares canvas selection, dragging, connections, layout, history and clipboard behavior.

singleImageToolbar.icon: Reuse the same Beta lingerie-try-on artwork as the initialization entry
singleImageToolbar.behavior: Create a lingerie editor linked to the selected image without uploading or duplicating the source image.

validation: Figma source read; no browser inspection or tests run, per user instruction.

workflow.assets: Reuse existing original Beta tip, upload, prompt-action, settings and generation artwork.
workflow.themes: Shared semantic tokens for Dark and Light; shared 200ms ease-out transitions.
behavior: A workflow kind stored in the existing editor settings distinguishes lingerie from fusion; legacy editors remain fusion.
Model images use a single-image asset picker or the existing canvas-selection flow with a one-image limit. Removing a model image allows replacement; changes support undo.
Clothing-image deletion leaves an empty lingerie node and resets its fields; adding clothing restores its connection and preserves the node position.
Copying an editor preserves its kind and configuration and pastes it without a clothing image.
Prompt expansion, prompt library, save, clear and generation settings reuse the existing controls.

User-authorized demo generation requires only a clothing image; description and model image may be empty. Each click adds the user-provided yellow/lavender lingerie model result at width 360 with its original 794:1064 aspect ratio, linked to the editor and labeled as a demo, with undo and arrangement support. Paired product/reference/result assets and prompts are recorded in workflow-example-images.json. No live AI request, charge or generation-history write.
